label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is TP: User input 'param' flows directly to 'url' at the sink 'new java.net.URL(url).openStream()' (L23). Although the code excludes '127.0.0.1' and 'localhost', it permits arbitrary hostnames (e.g., http://evil.com). The resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled input, enabling SSRF.

evidence.note: User input 'param' assigned to 'url' and used in URL construction without robust validation
